role: The command registry and dispatcher: maps names to ICommand objects and executes one line with permission checks, username-index selector expansion and error chat lines.
scope_reason: In scope since lane/idxclient: the chat takes typed input (GuiChat, the live client's T and slash), so a player types commands; the integrated server without cheats answers each (only tell, me, help and seed are allowed) and its tab completion reads the command map (csrc/engine/chatcmd.c).

members.name: commandMap
members.note: each name then its aliases in registration order; the HashMap's order from jorder.h (key_order)

members.name: commandSet
members.note: getPossibleCommands(sender) then Collections.sort: the allowed four by name

members.name: registerCommand
members.note: ServerCommandManager's registration as a table: the aliases after their name, a later alias never overwriting a command's own name

members.name: getUsernameIndex
members.note: tell's first argument, a selector that can match more than one player

notes: lane/idxclient: executeCommand for the one player without cheats (chatcmd.c execute): the command map (a table in registration order, its HashMap order computed), the not-found and permission lines, the username index loop (a null matchPlayers is the NullPointerException's commands.generic.exception), a CommandException inside processCommand as its red translation (a WrongUsageException too: the inner catch takes it before the outer), getPossibleCommands for tab completion. idx-chattype-s1.
